item.title: One dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
item.description:

NPS says it will implement stage four water restrictions beginning at 12:00 p.m. on Monday, saying the Saturday flooding caused "extensive damage to infrastructure," including the Transcanyon Waterline that supplies the park with water. Park officials say one person was killed and 15 may be missing after the flooding, though they say that is an estimate. Park officials confirmed they recovered the body of a 46-year-old man from the Colorado River on Sunday night. He has not been publicly identified. item.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
item.description:
Iceland voted against resuming talks to join the European Union, officials announced Sunday, as concerns over sovereignty trumped arguments for European integration. Icelandic voters rejected the measure amid widespread concern over maintaining control over fishing rights , a backbone of the country’s economy. The vote, which showed domestic concerns overriding geopolitical ones, comes as the resource-rich Arctic gains strategic importance , with US President Donald Trump pushing to acquire neighboring Greenland. Supporters of EU membership argued that closer ties with Europe could help strengthen the country’s security. The vote’s result is “a clear setback for Brussels,” an EU diplomat told Reuters, as the bloc seeks greater strategic weight at a time when European “security challenges are acute ,” a Carnegie Endowment scholar wrote. — Lauren Morganbesser
